observations.title: camera_id() narrows usize -> i32 with a bare `as` cast
observations.detail: src/render/context/camera_output.rs L294 `Ok(self.plan.cameras[camera_index] as i32)`; no checked conversion.
observations.fix_or_accept: ACCEPT now (camera ids come from the model ncam bound); when this file is next touched prefer i32::try_from + a documented invariant.

observations.title: depth() validates depth_scale after resolving the buffer region
observations.detail: depth() fetches depth_raw() (index/disabled/missing/length checks) before the DepthScale check; harness observed disabled + scale=0.0 -> ChannelDisabled, not DepthScale. Success paths unaffected.
observations.fix_or_accept: FIX (cheap): validate depth_scale before touching the buffer, or document the error precedence; ACCEPT: only combined-invalid inputs change which error is reported.

observations.title: README/receipt present -0.0 -> +0.0 as an upstream wp.clamp guarantee
observations.detail: warp 1.15 builtins.py documents clamp = min(max(low,x), high) and max with C fmax NaN semantics, which matches the product for NaN and out-of-range values; the tie between -0.0 and +0.0 is an fmaxf implementation detail (CUDA returns +0) and the fixtures contain no -0 samples, so it is not device-verified here.
observations.fix_or_accept: FIX wording (call it CUDA fmaxf behavior) and/or register the -0 case as uncovered; ACCEPT: none of the verified values changes.

observations.title: new() validates counts but not the provenance/monotonicity of the adr table
observations.detail: A hand-built OutputLayout with the same totals but permuted adr entries (e.g. [43200,0]) passes new() and silently yields swapped per-camera slices. README already states plan and layout must come from the same resolve().
observations.fix_or_accept: ACCEPT (precondition documented); optional hardening: compare adr against the prefix sums of plan pixels for enabled cameras.

observations.title: file location and module declaration disagree (#[path] from src/render/mod.rs)
observations.detail: The file lives under src/render/context/ but is declared as `render::camera_output` from src/render/mod.rs, so the module tree does not match the directory. Verified: no duplicate definition, context.rs untouched, module source registered (26 entries), normify validate --fingerprints 0 errors.
observations.fix_or_accept: ACCEPT for this slice (scope only covers src/render/context/ + src/render/mod.rs); follow-up: move the declaration into src/render/context.rs (or move the file) to remove the structural debt.

observations.title: PixelOverflow is unreachable on 64-bit targets and therefore untested
observations.detail: u32 width*height <= 2^64-2^33+1 < usize::MAX on 64-bit, and the plan prefix sums would need an absurd camera count; the variant is kept for 32-bit/future defense.
observations.fix_or_accept: ACCEPT: keep as defensive code; no test needed.

observations.title: product test's expected_depth uses f32::clamp, so NaN/-0 semantics are not covered by the product tests
observations.detail: tests/render_camera_output.rs implements the expectation with f32::clamp; the fixtures are finite non-negative, so equality holds. QA's independent harness covered 8 edge values (0/-0/0.5/1/1.5/-2/±inf/NaN) at 3 scales bit-exactly against the documented semantics.
observations.fix_or_accept: FIX (add 2-3 edge values to the product test) or register the edge cases as uncovered.

observations.title: fresh checkout cannot pass the pre-existing S3 fixture signature test under core.autocrlf=true
observations.detail: fixtures/g10-p5-primitive-branches/*.xml has no eol=lf attribute, so a fresh checkout gives CRLF bytes and g10_p5_branch_closure_cuda::fixtures_match_s3_signature fails; in the main worktree (LF bytes) it passes. NOT introduced by S1 (commit does not touch .gitattributes or those fixtures). QA worked around it by aligning the private worktree bytes with the main worktree (line-ending-only; 5042 files) before rerunning the gates.
observations.fix_or_accept: FIX via a small independent task: add `fixtures/g10-p5-primitive-branches/* text eol=lf` (or -text) to .gitattributes so gates are reproducible from a clean checkout.
